ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity predominance; approximately 92% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 8% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottle localized to the proximal-lateral margin of the left lobe trailing edge; scattered high-intensity focal points concentrated on the distal tips and medial margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped cleft with an estimated interior pixel angle of 42 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography; left lobe shows high-amplitude, low-frequency macro-serrations (large jagged voids), while the right lobe displays medium-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the continuous linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex sweep originating from the peduncle and terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle attachment scars) detected at the outer distal margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Five distinct high-contrast linear pixel disruptions; three parallel vertical tracks on the right mid-lobe and two diagonal tracks crossing the lower-medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and macro-level jaggedness on the trailing edge of the left lobe; multiple parallel rake marks (likely odontocete-induced) visible across the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme jaggedness of the left lobe's trailing edge provides a unique, highly identifiable geometric profile compared to the relatively more uniform right lobe.
